name: – Emma Ytterell – Commission proposal
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on speeding-up environmental assessments
part_text:
The report sets Parliament's position on a proposed law to speed up environmental assessments for plans and projects. It keeps the goal of faster decisions but changes how: it drops the special fast-track "toolbox" for selected strategic sectors, sets an overall limit of 300 days for assessments (extendable by 60), makes single contact points fully digital, and requires authorities to have enough qualified staff. It also removes the plan to let courts reject arguments not raised earlier.

- **What changes:** One 300-day limit for assessments, no special fast lane for chosen sectors, fully digital contact points.
- **Who it affects:** Project developers, national and local authorities, and the public consulted on projects.
- **What happens next:** Parliament negotiates with EU governments; the law is not final yet.
